subject: English
passage: In ancient Rome (27 BCE–476 CE), gladii ______ short swords that ranged in length from eighteen to twenty-four inches.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation:
Choice B is the best answer. The convention being tested is subject-verb agreement. The plural verb "were" agrees in number with the plural subject "gladii," which are described as plural "short swords."

Why D is incorrect:

Choice D is incorrect because the singular verb "has been" doesn't agree in number with the plural subject "gladii."
